remediatedAttempts.attempt: First red run of make e2e ISSUE=M1-024 before any M1-024 implementation file existed
remediatedAttempts.outcome: runner error script_root_missing, runner exit 66, Make exit 2, no result generated
remediatedAttempts.rootCause: the directory Tests/SystemTests/Scripts did not exist, so the runner stopped before it could look up the M1-024 script
remediatedAttempts.resolution: the system script was authored at the exact path the runner resolves, which moved the failure to a missing fixture instead of a missing script root

remediatedAttempts.attempt: Second red run of make e2e ISSUE=M1-024 after the first incomplete system script existed
remediatedAttempts.outcome: script exit 1, runner disposition script_failed, Make exit 2, no result generated
remediatedAttempts.rootCause: the sanitized fixture pair had not been released yet, so the script failed closed on a missing input rather than reporting not executed
remediatedAttempts.resolution: the released sanitized bytes and their metadata were placed in the working tree, and the fail-closed behaviour on a missing fixture was kept and is now covered by the missing-payload-file mutation check

remediatedAttempts.attempt: Third red run of make e2e ISSUE=M1-024 after the fixture pair was placed in the working tree
remediatedAttempts.outcome: script exit 1 reporting that evidence/issues/M1-024/commands.json was missing, Make exit 2, no result generated
remediatedAttempts.rootCause: the evidence package was incomplete, and the script validates every required evidence input before it writes a result
remediatedAttempts.resolution: the remaining evidence files were authored from real tool output; exact timestamps for this run were not captured, so it is recorded here rather than in the machine-readable red phase

remediatedAttempts.attempt: First run of the private mutation harness
remediatedAttempts.outcome: 14 of 15 mutations were rejected; the non-canonical base64 case exited 0 instead of failing
remediatedAttempts.rootCause: the harness mutated an unpadded base64 quantum, which stays canonical, so the mutated document was a valid fixture and the validator was right to accept it
remediatedAttempts.resolution: the harness was corrected to flip the pad bits of a padded quantum; the rerun rejected that case and every other case, and no validator rule was weakened

remediatedAttempts.attempt: Attempt 7 of the bounded observation, whose sanitized bytes were the previous uncommitted working-tree fixture
remediatedAttempts.outcome: the observation itself completed inside the bounded window and its sanitized document was well formed, but it was superseded; its bytes were never committed and never entered git history, and attempt 8 replaced them in the working tree
remediatedAttempts.rootCause: GitHub Issue 17 requires build, OS, hardware, network, keyboard layout, display and peer metadata to be recorded before capture; for attempt 7 those facts were only queried afterwards, so the procedure had a recording-order gap and retroactive conformance was never claimed
remediatedAttempts.resolution: the same non-sensitive host and peer facts were recorded first and are now in environment.json, then the identical verified procedure ran again as attempt 8, whose bytes are the fixture intended for commit; attempt 7 was set aside for that procedural gap alone and not for its content

remediatedAttempts.attempt: Author-phase commit self-reference in commands.json, environment.json and tests/e2e-validation.json
remediatedAttempts.outcome: each file recorded a commit that the validator required to equal the current head, which the resulting tree could never satisfy because committing those files moves the head
remediatedAttempts.rootCause: the author-phase records were labelled as the implementation commit although the author ran every check with the eleven implementation-author Exact Files still uncommitted, so the only truthful value available was the head they ran over
remediatedAttempts.resolution: the field is now repositoryHeadAtAuthorRun and the validator requires it to be a full commit id that is an ancestor of, or equal to, the current head, checked read-only with git merge-base --is-ancestor and failing closed when it is malformed, unresolvable or outside the current history
